notes.title: Stealthscape - NOW 100% FREE... FOREVER!
notes.notes:
Hey all! It's been over a year since the initial launch of Stealthscape and I've been doing some thinking.
Stealthscape is a game I worked on for a collective 4 years, a lot of blood, sweat, and tears were put into making it. Upon release, the game did not meet expectations, but no first release does. I didn't even know what to expect.

But as I've moved on from Stealthscape, I've realized that I don't want this game sitting on Steam with next to no user-base. The game was designed to have competitive leaderboards within a community, a limitless Stage Editor for you to share your ideas within a community, and so much more. But there never really was a community.

So I've decided to make Stealthscape 100% free for anyone to pickup and play. No microtransactions, no paid DLC, everything is 100% free. I want more people to experience this game I worked so hard towards making, and this was the best way to go about doing so. I hope you all respect my decision :)

Get Stealthscape now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/670720/Stealthscape/

You can also get the game's Soundtrack here if you'd like to support me:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1390100/Soundscape__Stealthscape_OST/

Thank you all for following me on this journey! See you all on the leaderboards :)

[list]
[*] Full Controller Support
[*] World H
[*] World H's post-world content
[*] 3 new Music Tracks
[*] More Palettes to unlock
[*] 8 new Ships to unlock
[*] 10 new Trails to unlock
[*] New FX Customizations
[*] The ability to beat the game
[/list]

On top of all this, Stealthscape will release alongside [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1390100/Soundscape__Stealthscape_OST/]"Soundscape", Stealthscape's OST[/url], which you can buy for $1.99 if you'd like to use the music in your own projects (with credit) or to support me :)

notes.title: Stealthscape Early Access Roadmap
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32417737/26461d67dfe5bebf56163dbaad55c51542af8d0a.png[/img]

[h1]Early Access Roadmap[/h1]

During Early Access there will be a schedule to updates, aswell as Q&A/Development livestreams on Twitch. Here's a brief rundown of what's to expect.

[h2]Every Saturday[/h2]

Every Saturday, a new build will be pushed to the "weekly" branch in the Betas tab. These builds will contain all new content as it's being made, but are less stable. Each week, you can expect around 5 new stages to play in the Campaign, along with new content as suggested by the Trello, aswell as you! Weekly builds will not contain story elements as they're being made, and will only be made available with major update releases. Major update builds are still pushed to the weekly branch so you don't have to swap between them when you want to play each one!

[h2]Every Sunday[/h2]

Every Sunday (Excluding Tomorrow) I will be livestreaming the development of Stealthscape on [url=https://twitch.tv/cklidify]Twitch[/url] at 6:00pm Eastern Time. The first bit of the stream will be me going over everything new in the weekly build released the day prior, aswell as what's planned for the current week. After this, I will stream regular development of the game, with some stage creation at the end. During this portion of the stream, I will be answering any questions you have in chat, and taking suggestions from those who have them. If you have the time to drop by, please feel free!

[h2]Every Month[/h2]

Major updates will be released on the first Wednesday of each month (Excluding April). These updates will contain everything from the weekly builds released throughout the month, plus everything that was in the work behind-the-scenes, such as Story Missions! These updates are expected to include 1 new Campaign World each month, with new customization options and Stage Editor content sprinkled throughout.


I hope you're all excited for the Early Access Release of Stealthscape, the game releases in only 2 DAYS!!! So add to your wishlists now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/670720/Stealthscape/

notes.title: STEALTHSCAPE EARLY ACCESS - MARCH 30
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=4cTWV_0cQmM;full][/previewyoutube]

Stealthscape is finally coming to Steam in Early Access! Add to wishlist and mark your calendars, cause the big day's [b]March 30th, 2020[/b]

[h2]What Does Early Access Mean?[/h2]

After years of development, Stealthscape is in a fully playable state and is near fully-featured. But the Campaign will require more time to complete, and there's still so much planned for the game. But not only that, there's potentially so much YOU will have planned for the game. If you have any feature requests, new object ideas, issues, bugs or what have you, feel free to [b][url=https://discord.gg/MTeq58B]join our discord[/url][/b] and let me know in the [b]#feedback[/b] channel, I want this game to be the best it can be and I can't do that alone.


[h2]What's in the Early Access version?[/h2]
[list]
[*]2 Worlds in the Campaign (At Launch)
[*]Gold Coins to find throughout the Campaign stages
[*]Story-based missions you encounter between each world
[*]Gauntlet Runs that have you speedrun through an entire world in one sitting
[*]A fully-featured Stage Editor with limitless options and features
[*]Steam Workshop support for sharing custom stages
[*]An XP/Customization Unlock system that allows you to customize your ship with different models, trails, and FX
[/list]
There will also be a weekly branch available which will contain more unstable builds, but you will get content as it's being developed. Development is being shared in the discord constantly.


[h2]What's to come?[/h2]
[list]
[*]More Campaign worlds (9 in total)
[*]A Story completed in missions between worlds throughout the game
[*]More objects, enemies and traps to create stages with
[*]More customization unlocks for your ship
[*]Gameplay modifiers that fundamentally change how the game is played in exchange for a point modifier
[*]Statistics to get feedback on how you play
[*]Steam Achievements and Trading Cards
[/list]

Hope to see you all on the leaderboards on March 30th!
